Subject: Subprocessor roster + telemetry residency request

Hi Priyom / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — we’re moving fast on our security intake. To close our SIG-lite and procurement checklist we need the following evidence from Redwood by EOD Friday (2027-06-11):

- Up-to-date subprocessor roster (CSV) including: service, provider name, region of processing, and purpose.
- SOC 2 Type II attestation (latest report or link).
- Telemetry & logs retention matrix: which telemetry we collect, retention windows by region, and how logs are stored/encrypted.
- Clarify KMS ownership and key residency for customer data (do you use customer-managed keys for Private deployments?).
- Any CAIQ responses you can share specific to data residency and subprocessor management.

If some items are confidential, a redacted bundle or an evidence call + secure share link works — whatever speeds review. We may need a short 30-minute call to confirm a few items; please include available slots.

Best,
Alice
Alice Morgan
Security Program Manager | MedNexus Health
alice.morgan@mednexus.com

Alice — thanks for the clear list and timeline. We can meet that Friday EOD; proposed plan below:

1) Today: share a working subprocessor CSV and a SOC 2 redacted PDF (attachments).
2) Wed (2027-06-09): deliver telemetry retention matrix and a short note on KMS/residency per deployment type (Hosted/Dedicated/Private).
3) Thu (2027-06-10): provide CAIQ extract sections relevant to data residency & subprocessor controls plus a secure Drive bundle.
4) Fri: lock any outstanding clarifications in a 30-min call if you need live walkthrough.

We’ll include an evidence index so you can track which file corresponds to which SIG item. Ben — can you confirm the CSV export and the SOC 2 redaction by EOD today? Laura — can you own the telemetry table?

Priyom

Priyom — CSV exported and sanity-checked. A few implementation notes to surface for Alice:

- The roster includes runtime deps (serving runtime), telemetry collectors (in-house + third-party instrumentation), and backup storage providers. We marked residency at the country level; for multi-region providers we included the primary region we use.
- SOC 2 PDF is redacted for internal IP and vendor pricing sections; it includes our control mappings to common criteria.
- KMS: For hosted API we manage keys; for Private deployments we support customer-managed keys via KMS integrations (we’ll specify supported providers and residency options in the KMS note).

Laura — please attach the telemetry matrix when ready and I’ll add a column for encryption-at-rest status.

— Ben

Thanks — that timeline looks good. We received the CSV and SOC 2 redaction; appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple of small asks before the drive bundle:

- Can you include an explicit column in the roster for "subprocessor_role" (e.g., telemetry, backups, inference runtime, metrics) so our mapping is simpler?
- Please confirm whether any telemetry contains PII (we need a yes/no per telemetry stream).
- For the KMS note: list supported cloud KMS providers and whether keys can be restricted to a specific region.

Let’s tentatively book a 30-min call Friday (2027-06-11) at 10:00 AM PT — I’ll send a calendar invite if that slot works. Also, can you upload the CAIQ snippets and telemetry matrix to the Drive link you provided and share a DocuSign-ready acknowledgement (we need an evidence receipt signature for procurement)?

If you prefer, I can open a secure ticket and we can exchange the more sensitive artifacts there.

Best,
Alice
